message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/yara && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"rules_fuzzer input","code":"YARA rules file parsed by libFuzzer target","note":"The attacker controls a rule string that reaches the parser and regexp compiler."},
  {"step":2,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration","line":571,"var":"re_ast","code":"yr_re_parse(str->c_string, &re_ast, &re_error)","note":"The regexp text is parsed into an AST from the attacker-controlled string."},
  {"step":3,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":456,"var":"re_ast->root_node","code":"if (re_ast->root_node->type != RE_NODE_CONCAT) return ERROR_SUCCESS;","note":"The AST is checked for a concatenation that can be split into chained pieces."},
  {"step":4,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":468,"var":"child","code":"if (!child->greedy && child->type == RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY && (child->start > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD || child->end > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD))","note":"A large non-greedy wildcard range satisfies the chaining heuristic and enters the split path."},
  {"step":5,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":472,"var":"remainder_re_ast","code":"yr_re_ast_create(remainder_re_ast)","note":"A second AST is created to hold the suffix after the split."},
  {"step":6,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":480,"var":"re_ast->root_node->children_head","code":"re_ast->root_node->children_head = child->next_sibling;","note":"The original AST is mutated in place, detaching the split node from the tree that will still be used by the parser."},
  {"step":7,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":493,"var":"child","code":"yr_re_node_destroy(child);","note":"The detached node is freed while the parser continues processing the same logical regexp declaration."},
  {"step":8,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"_yr_parser_write_string","line":335,"var":"literal_string","code":"literal_string = yr_re_ast_extract_literal(re_ast);","note":"The parser immediately reuses the mutated AST to derive a literal string for atom extraction."},
  {"step":9,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_extract_literal","line":365,"var":"child","code":"child = re_ast->root_node->children_tail; while (child != NULL && child->type == RE_NODE_LITERAL)","note":"Literal extraction walks the tree after the split/free sequence, so it can observe stale structure."},
  {"step":10,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"_yr_parser_write_string","line":383,"var":"literal_string->c_string","code":"yr_atoms_extract_from_string(..., (uint8_t*) literal_string->c_string, (int32_t) literal_string->length, ...)","note":"The extracted literal bytes are consumed to build atoms, which is the memory-safety sink if the literal pointer is stale."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/yara/t5000.rules /workspace/candidate_trace.json >/tmp/submit2.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; cat /tmp/submit2.log | tail -120
